linkingRules.description: Thematic cross-linking between curated articles, blog posts, and essential guides based on topic categories
linkingRules.strategy: Create discovery pathways so readers naturally flow between related content: daily curation → relevant blog post → foundational guide

workers_rights.label: Workers' Rights & Compensation
workers_rights.cta: Learning about your workplace rights? Get the complete WSIB guide.

disability_benefits.label: Disability Benefits Navigation
disability_benefits.cta: Applying for disability benefits? Start with our step-by-step application guides.

accessibility_rights.label: Accessibility & Inclusive Design
accessibility_rights.cta: Know your accessibility rights. We have guides for legal claims and inclusive design.

legal_victories.label: Legal Victories & Rights
legal_victories.cta: Stay informed on disability rights wins. We break down legal decisions that affect you.

health_wellness.label: Health & Wellness Support
health_wellness.cta: Struggling with mental health or chronic illness? We have evidence-based support resources.

community_action.label: Community Action & Events
community_action.cta: Get involved. See upcoming events, campaigns, and community spotlights.

curated_to_blog.description: When curated article matches blog topic, link to related blog post
curated_to_blog.example: Curated article about WSIB → Link to 'WSIB Claims 101' blog post

blog_to_guide.description: Blog posts link to foundational essential guides for deeper learning
blog_to_guide.trigger: Blog post tags match guide topics
blog_to_guide.placement: Related links section at end of post
blog_to_guide.template: Want the full story? Read our complete guide: [Guide Title]
blog_to_guide.example: Blog post about WSIB return-to-work → Essential Guide: 'Return-to-Work Planning'

curation_to_guide.description: Curated articles in essential topics link directly to guides
curation_to_guide.trigger: Article is about perennial topic (not breaking news)
curation_to_guide.example: CPP-D eligibility article → Essential Guide: 'CPP-D: Step-by-Step Application'

related_articles_sidebar.description: Show 2-3 related articles from same topic cluster
related_articles_sidebar.trigger: Reader viewing article in specific cluster
related_articles_sidebar.template: You might also want to read: [Article 1] [Article 2]
related_articles_sidebar.example: Reader on Workers Rights article → See 2 more workers rights articles

topic_cross_reference.description: When article touches multiple topics, link to related clusters
topic_cross_reference.trigger: Article contains keywords from 2+ topic clusters
topic_cross_reference.template: Also interested in [Topic]? Explore our [Topic] collection
topic_cross_reference.example: Accessibility + workplace accommodation → Link to both accessibility AND workers rights sections

jekyll_liquid_filters: {% assign related_posts = site.posts | where_exp: 'p', "p.tags contains 'category'" | limit: 3 %}

automated_tagging.process: During curation, articles automatically tagged by curator.json scoring category

tagging_rules.workers_rights: WSIB, workplace injury, workers compensation score > 3.5
tagging_rules.accessibility_rights: accessibility, AODA, barrier, universal design score > 3.5
tagging_rules.health_wellness: mental health, chronic illness, wellness score > 2.5

guide_linking_rules.essential_guides_index: Links to guides from topic cluster main page
guide_linking_rules.blog_posts: Feature spotlights and curation summaries include 'Learn more' links
guide_linking_rules.navigation: Topic cluster navigation shows 'Jump to Essential Guide' for evergreen topics
guide_linking_rules.search: Search results include guide results when topic-related

optimization_triggers.low_ctr_links: If link CTR < 5%, revise link text and placement
optimization_triggers.unused_guides: If guide traffic < 20/day, feature more prominently
optimization_triggers.broken_paths: If readers leaving without exploring related content, add more links
optimization_triggers.topic_confusion: If readers bouncing between unrelated topics, improve category clarity

reader_journey_example.step_1: Newsletter headline: 'WSIB rate increase just passed'
reader_journey_example.step_2: Reader clicks → Curated article with full news
reader_journey_example.step_3: Sidebar link: 'Want to understand WSIB appeals? Read our guide'
reader_journey_example.step_4: Reader explores → Essential Guide: WSIB Appeals
reader_journey_example.step_5: Reader sees blog link: 'Return-to-Work Success Stories'
reader_journey_example.step_6: Reader engaged, exploring 4 different content pieces on related topics
